t.zh: 已知 sound 说判定程序是对的：taut x 算出真，x 就永远成立。它只要对所有公式证一次（对公式归纳）。
t.en: The given sound says the decision procedure is right: if taut x works out true, x always holds. It needs proving only once, for every formula (by induction on formulas).

after.zh: 这条路叫<wiki-ref to="reflection"></wiki-ref>，Lean 的 decide 就是这样做的。
after.en: This way is called <wiki-ref to="reflection"></wiki-ref>, and it is how Lean’s decide works.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

stated: ev(neg(z), x, y) = bnot(ev(z, x, y))
ev(conj(z, w), x, y) = band(ev(z, x, y), ev(w, x, y))
ev(disj(z, w), x, y) = bor(ev(z, x, y), ev(w, x, y))
taut(z) = band(ev(z, tt, tt), band(ev(z, tt, ff), band(ev(z, ff, tt), ev(z, ff, ff))))

hint.zh: sound 要一个 taut x = 真 的证明。核会按定义算。
hint.en: sound wants a proof of taut x = true, and the kernel computes by the definitions.

hint.en: As in the first, x is read off the sentence to prove.
